title: Category Filter
description: A faceted filter sidebar beside a category's products, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Accordion, Checkbox, Slider, Drawer, Button, Alert and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading and a sentence of introduction, then one Accordion item per facet with a Checkbox per option and its count, a price range Slider, and "Clear all"; the products are the consumer's children, and every change is reported as { options, price }; has its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — below @md the facets move into a Drawer from the left, opened by a "Filters" button that shows how many are active; the button sits beside the heading at @sm, the sidebar sits beside the products and the heading steps up at @md, and the sidebar widens with more room above and below at @lg.
